literal: Hill having climbed elephant battle like seeing, one's own hand something to be he who does action.
translation: Undertaking a venture with one's own wealth in hand is like safely watching an elephant battle from a hilltop.
modern: தன் கையில் சொந்தப் பொருள் இருக்க ஒரு செயலைத் தொடங்குவது, ஒருவன் பாதுகாப்பான குன்றின் மேல் ஏறி நின்று யானைப் போரை வேடிக்கை பார்ப்பதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of financial independence when undertaking a project. Just as a person standing on a high hill can safely watch a fierce battle between elephants without fear of getting trampled, a person who uses their own wealth to fund an enterprise can execute it with confidence. Relying on one's own resources removes the anxiety and risks associated with depending on others.
